title: xEdge Core Configuration
description: Schema for the core section of xedge.yaml (FR-CM-001). Per-driver schemas are loaded and validated independently by the driver framework (FR-DF-004).

schema_version.description: Config schema version, e.g. '0.1'. Used by the migration tool (NFR-M-003).

interval_seconds.description: Must kick at least once per 30s per NFR-R-005; default kicks at 2x that margin.

drivers.description: Driver instances. Each driver's `config` and `tag_groups` are validated against that driver type's own schema (FR-DF-004) — not enumerated here in Sprint 1.
